pages: Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, stands at a kitchen bench turning one white electric kettle in his hands, head on one side. Middle distance: a toaster and two mugs. Background: the kitchen window and a fridge, flat cold morning light.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, stops at a shop shelf and puts one tin can back facing out, counting along the row with two fingers. Middle distance: two more tins and a wire basket. Background: the shop window, daylight through glass.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, runs a finger along one iron hook set into the clubhouse wall. Middle distance: a stack of patrol flags and a folded rescue tube. Background: the sand through the open door, bright morning light.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, lifts one flat red sand-safety board onto an iron hook on the open clubhouse wall, arms up. Middle distance: a row of bare iron hooks and a coil of rope. Background: the beach and a grey-brown sea, hard offshore wind.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, stands on wet sand with one red sand-safety board under his arm, looking east past the point. Middle distance: a yellow patrol flag and a rescue tube on the shingle. Background: white-topped water and a low grey sky.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, drags one long rescue tube up the shingle with both hands. Middle distance: wet footprints and a folded board on the stones. Background: the surf line and figures far up the beach, flat grey light.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, stands at one long wooden table with both hands flat on its edge, answering. Middle distance: chairs pushed back and a thick club book lying closed. Background: the clubhouse window with rain running down the glass.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, stands with one hand on his bicycle handlebar outside the clubhouse. Middle distance: a wet saddle and a mudguard thick with rain. Background: the car park tarmac and a low grey sky.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, sits at the kitchen table tapping one tablet screen with a fingertip. Middle distance: a half-lowered blind and a glass of water. Background: the kitchen window and the back of a chair, soft indoor light.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, sits in the exam chair beside one desk with a single warm lamp over it. Middle distance: a letter chart on the wall and a black case on the desk. Background: a dim consulting room and one tall window.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, holds one cardboard plate book open with its turned flap stopped, a fingertip resting on it. Middle distance: the desk edge and a pen. Background: the dim room and the one warm lamp.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, stands at the window with one cardboard plate book open on the sill in daylight. Middle distance: a lowered blind and a bentwood chair. Background: the bright window glass and the street outside.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, sits with his hands on his knees while one cardboard plate book lies closed on the desk. Middle distance: the desk lamp and a chair back. Background: the dim room and one high window.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, keeps one hand flat on the desk and his face turned up, listening. Middle distance: a box of lens samples and a pen. Background: the dim consulting room, lamplight on a bare wall.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, points one fingertip at his own eye while he listens, brow furrowed. Middle distance: the desk edge and a closed plate book. Background: the dim consulting room and a warm lamp overhead.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, holds one red apple up at eye level and turns it slowly, watching it. Middle distance: a second apple on the desk and a lens case. Background: the dim room and one warm lamp.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, balances one small coin on his fingertip and holds his hand up to the light. Middle distance: the open plate book and a desk edge. Background: the dim room with daylight at the window.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, stands in the doorway with one paper folder under his arm. Middle distance: the desk with the lamp still on and a pushed-back chair. Background: the clinic corridor and its window, daylight.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, holds one flat red sand-safety board at chest height, a wide white letter brushed across it. Middle distance: an open paint can and a stencil. Background: the clubhouse wall and its iron hooks, bright morning light.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, writes on the back of one flat red sand-safety board with a black marker. Middle distance: two iron hooks above the clubhouse door and a paint tray. Background: the sand and the sea beyond, morning light.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, stands on the club step holding one flat red sand-safety board out at arm's length in flat light. Middle distance: the clubhouse wall and one iron hook. Background: flat sea and a pale summer sky.

Hamish, a boy of thirteen with short sandy hair, a navy club rash vest and grey board shorts, holds one manila folder flat against his chest on the clinic step, and does not open it. Middle distance: a clinic window and a low handrail. Background: the Parade footpath in bright afternoon light.
